question: What is the maximum spend on a laptop or tablet for an IAS, IPS or IFS officer?

gold_grs_detail.title: To Provide Computer/Laptop/Tablet/IPad to Government Officials/Employees..
To Provide Computer/Laptop/Tablet/IPad to Government Officials/Employees.

product.answer: The maximum spend on a laptop or tablet for an IAS, IPS or IFS officer is Rs. 120,000, as set by the 2023 GR which superseded the 2019 GR that had Rs. 85,000. No other GR in the corpus changes this.
